notes.title: 2024-06-22 - Development update!
notes.content:
Raider camps:
Raiders are infiltrating the forest. Are they friends or foes? Find out as Iki's curiosity rarely holds her back.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/5be83a8ac6194e6c7ed2c3c898edce3fc11fcc6b.jpg

New creatures:
The massive Mossback has appeared in the forest. Usually a timid and kind beast, but something seems to have stirred his emotions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/332907c99eb070249cf041f352753ed6d4ec38ad.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/394abe204e692d4eb252aa76eee48753c86cfdc9.jpg

Merchant:
Slithering around the various regions of the forest we’ll sometimes run into our friendly slimy merchant, selling all kinds of goodies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/cd0932f112e0a8c3073ed8a4d3c62167fd6d07e0.jpg

Sewing lodge:
By obtaining the necessary building materials, the sewing lodger can be built. Allowing Iki and Tika to be able to create new clothes - making them stronger but most importantly more fashionable!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/b5d7351888c3950791e98d491f7883a978593595.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/a6f179ed48b0038a3df03d13d00fe4f669cacecb.jpg

Cosmetics:
The game currently features 10 cosmetic outfits for Iki and 10 outfits for Tika. Here’s a preview for some of Iki’s cosmetics:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/83c0554ee39b10b7205352bb9db5b68fa38725f2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693980/716f6f0e89df35f92012d8c93d5e668a27cf8296.jpg

notes.title: Demo update 1
notes.content:
Hi! Some time has now passed since the demo was released. Thank you so much for trying out the game at this early stage, it has provided a lot of nice feedback and information!

The demo will now get a small update:

- Implemented jumping
- Fixed UI bug in storage
- Fixed UI bug in inventory
- Fixed several visual bugs

The rest of the game is progressing nicely. Can’t wait to show the world the full release of Children of the Forest!
